definitions.gloss: outside the body; extracorporeal; external to the body
definitions.explanation: Referring to something that occurs or exists outside the body. Used primarily in medical and biological contexts.

examples.japanese: {体外|たいがい}⟦{受精|じゅせい}→受精：29502_jusei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{授|さず}かった→授かる：12797_sazukaru⟧。
examples.english: They conceived a child through in vitro fertilization.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{体外|たいがい}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{排出|はいしゅつ}→排出：04632_haishutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。
examples.english: It takes time for the drug to be expelled from the body.

examples.japanese: {体外|たいがい}{式|しき}{除細動器|じょさいどうき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧AED⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧、⟦{公共|こうきょう}{施設|しせつ}→公共施設：17944_koukyoushisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: External defibrillators, also called AEDs, are installed in public facilities.

notes: Composed of ⟦{体|たい}→体：09872_tai⟧ (body) + ⟦{外|がい}→外〜：03948_gai⟧ (outside). The opposite is ⟦{体内|たいない}→体内：11556_tainai⟧ (inside the body). Common collocations: {体外|たいがい}⟦{受精|じゅせい}→受精：29502_jusei⟧ (in vitro fertilization / IVF), {体外|たいがい}⟦{診断|しんだん}→診断：04209_shindan⟧ (in vitro diagnostics), {体外|たいがい}{式|しき} (external type). Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{大概|たいがい}→大概：12183_taigai⟧ (generally; mostly; enough already). {体外|たいがい}⟦{受精|じゅせい}→受精：29502_jusei⟧ is a widely discussed topic in Japan as the country grapples with declining birth rates — IVF treatment is now partially covered by health insurance.
